title: Intermittent errors in One-Way UI
description: Umbrella Media: One-Way UI shows ERR_UPSTREAM randomly, mostly during their afternoon batch. Chat UI mostly fine.
resolution_notes: q.ratelimit lines at the gateway: rpm=85 vs limit 60 for the tenant. One-Way UI has no retry (ui.retry.enabled=false), so the first 429 surfaces as ERR_UPSTREAM. Interim: raised llm.ratelimit.per_tenant_rpm to 120 for the tenant.
